candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because the order service returns 502, which is caused by the payment service returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; the payment dependency failure propagates up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 as the deepest error, but payment-side logs/metrics are absent, so the underlying payment fault (config, saturation, crash) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with order returning 502, which traces to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory/redis calls succeed. Root fault lies at payment, but its internal cause is not yet observed.
